description: This source file defines the class 'GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver' which manages the mapping between Grain interface types and Grain types within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes methods for resolving grain types based on interface types and prefixes, caching mechanisms, and interactions with cluster manifests.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver
classes.description: Manages the resolution and caching of GrainType objects based on GrainInterfaceType inputs, supporting prefix-based lookup and handling generic grain types.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A nested class within the resolver that stores cached mappings from GrainInterfaceType to CacheEntry, including versioning for cache invalidation.

classes.name: CacheEntry
classes.description: A struct representing the primary GrainType implementation and additional implementations with prefixes for a specific GrainInterfaceType.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the GrainType associated with a given GrainInterfaceType and optional prefix, with logic to handle exact and prefix matches.

methods.name: TryGetGrainType
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a GrainType for a given GrainInterfaceType, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache, rebuilding it if the cluster manifest version has changed.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Constructs a new cache mapping from the cluster manifest, associating interface types with their implementations.
